query.title: Search keyword
query.description: Job keyword to search on jobs.ie, e.g. 'software developer', 'nurse'. Not required when startUrls is provided.

radius.title: Radius (km)
radius.description: Search radius around the location, in km. Requires a location.

age.title: Posted within (days)
age.description: Only return jobs posted within this many days.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Direct jobs.ie search or detail URLs to scrape. Overrides query/location for URL building.

includeDetails.title: Fetch detail pages
includeDetails.description: Fetch each job's detail page for full description, salary, ISO dates and enrichment. Slower but much richer.

descriptionFormat.title: Description format
descriptionFormat.description: Output format for the job description (requires Fetch detail pages).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: full = return all jobs found. incremental = only return jobs not seen in previous runs (requires stateStoreName).

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named key-value store for incremental state. Use the same name across scheduled runs. Scoped per query+location.

compact.title: Compact output
compact.description: Emit only the essential fields (jobKey, title, company, location, url, portalUrl, datePosted, workFromHome, unifiedSalary, geo, description). AI/MCP-friendly.

descriptionMaxLength.title: Description max length
descriptionMaxLength.description: Truncate the description to this many characters (appends '…'). 0 = no truncation.

outputFields.title: Output fields
outputFields.description: Return only this subset of output fields. Empty = all fields.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of listings to return (0 = unlimited).

maxPages.title: Max search pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to crawl.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy configuration. Residential proxy is recommended for jobs.ie.
